node.agent_main_desc: Orchestrator: receives task, delegates to sub-agents, synthesizes results.
node.agent_research_desc: Gathers information: web search, document parsing, source validation.
node.agent_ux_desc: Analyzes design and UX: heuristics, accessibility, visual review.
node.agent_analytics_desc: Works with data: pattern detection, anomalies, structured reports.
node.tool_search_desc: Find fresh information on the web. Used by agents for up-to-date data.
node.tool_file_desc: Read PDF, CSV, Word, Markdown. Extract text and tables.
node.tool_vision_desc: Analyze images: screenshots, photos, designs, charts.
node.tool_memory_desc: Long-term storage between runs: preferences, history, context.
node.trigger_input_desc: Workflow entry point. Receives data from user.
node.agent_code_desc: Reviews code: bugs, style, security; suggests fixes.
node.agent_designer_desc: Helps with UI/UX: layouts, interface copy, visual choices.
node.agent_content_desc: Writes copy: articles, posts, descriptions in a given style.
node.tool_code_exec_desc: Capability to run code and return computed results.
node.tool_computer_desc: Capability to control the screen/browser (screenshots, clicks).
node.tool_citations_desc: Capability to answer with links to sources.
node.tool_mcp_desc: Connect external tools and data via MCP.
node.output_telegram_desc: Deliver the result to a Telegram chat via a bot.

welcome.subtitle: Want a quick 2-minute tour? We'll cover the core flow together.

step1.title: Node palette
step1.body: On the left is your palette. Drag a Main Agent onto the canvas to start.

step2.title: Tools
step2.body: Nice. Now add a tool — Web Search or Files. Tools give your agent abilities.

step3.title: Connections
step3.body: Connect agent to tool: drag a line from the bottom handle of one node to the top handle of another.

step4.title: Run
step4.body: Press Run to execute your workflow in demo mode. No real API calls yet.

step5.title: Execution logs
step5.body: The bottom panel shows agents working step-by-step. In real mode this will show actual Claude API responses.

validation.title: Check the workflow before running
validation.noAgent: No agent node — nothing to run. Add at least one agent node.
validation.isolated: Some nodes aren't connected (not part of the flow)
validation.multi-trigger: Multiple start nodes — the flow may run differently than expected
validation.output-empty: An output node isn't connected to anything — there will be no result
validation.tool-unattached: A tool isn't attached to any agent — it won't be used
